inference_design: First eligible encounter ordered by encounter_id for each of 41,994 development patients; Holm correction for five prespecified tests at family-wise alpha 0.05. Encounter ID is only an ordering proxy. H1's chi-square is an omnibus test; its stated direction is checked using 2+ versus zero prior admissions, not assumed to prove a monotonic dose response.
descriptive_caution: Chart rates describe encounters, including repeat encounters. Administrative levels below 1% of training encounters are pooled; unpooled counts are also saved. All risk segments are exploratory with at least 100 encounters; their sample size is not an independent-patient count.
key_business_insights: The training partition contains 59,814 encounters from 41,994 patients; 6,846 (11.45%) were readmitted within 30 days. Always predicting no readmission would be 88.55% accurate, so accuracy alone is misleading.
Prior inpatient burden is useful for triage: no prior visits had 8.6% readmission (39,712 encounters), while 5+ had 37.0% (1,195); H1 adjusted p=3.53e-95.
Mean stay was 4.78 days for readmitted encounters versus 4.33 days for others; a distribution test below checks the association on independent patients.
Among age groups with at least 100 encounters, [80-90) had the highest observed rate, 13.0% (1,288/9,915); age alone should not decide access to care.
Injury was the highest-rate primary diagnosis group at 12.7% (527/4,144), helping define a follow-up workflow.
Discharge to Rehabilitation facility had 28.0% readmission (330/1,177); transitions of care deserve review.
Insulin status 'Down' had 14.6% readmission (7,195 encounters). This may reflect illness severity; it is not evidence that insulin causes readmission.
A1C category 'Not tested' had 11.8% readmission (49,700 encounters); testing patterns and patient mix can confound this comparison.
The 31+-medication group had the highest observed medication-band rate, 13.2% (2,969 encounters), suggesting medication review as an operational hypothesis.
Highest observed segment: 40–59 / Digestive / 2+ prior: 29.3% (91/311), 2.6× overall. Exploratory ranking needs prospective validation.
